snippet.title: Kakatte Koi Yo! - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist or buy: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145380/Kakatte_Koi_Yo/

Kakatte Koi Yo! is a cute 2D platform fighter where you play as cats, use fish with special powers to fight, and achieve victory! Challenge your friends in 1v1, 2v2, and free for all combat, or hone your skills in the single player time trials.

Learn out more about Backslash Game: https://backslashgames.weebly.com/
